Review and potentially restart AI processes to ensure they are operating correctly and generating insights.
Evaluate the performance of active trading strategies to ensure they are configured correctly and capable of executing trades.

recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting trading operations.
